name: x_rules_multiball_lockout_2
description: rules mode, 2 balls: ball 0 from multi_bounce_upper, slot 1 from diagonal_wall_hit. EP9-13 keep one sensor lockout per ball (ds:3880+2i, copied into ds:388b around each ball's pixel scan and decremented per frame per slot); a lockout set by one ball's handler must not block the other ball's sensors. The port with a single lockout diverges at record 25 (collided).
